newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner new shares priced at 65 marks.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner new shares priced at 65 marks.

text.p: Germany's Dresdner Bank AG said on Thursday that it would offer new shares at an issue price of 65 marks in a one-for-20 rights offering to increase its nominal capital by 120 million marks.
The subscription period for the new shares runs from August 14 to August 28, the bank said in a mandatory statement. The new shares will be entitled to half the full-dividend for 1997.
Dresdner said it would publish details of the subscription offer on August 9.
The issue price of 65 marks represents a discount of 15.70 marks to Thursday's closing price of 80.70 marks.
Dresdner announced last week it would increase capital to establish a "war chest" for a possible acquisition abroad.
The bank said it aimed to broaden its investment banking business and would focus on the U.S. in its search for a possible acquisition.
